test_title: PYST 18: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 30 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

ISLE : GNVL :: JUMP : ROXM :: KATE : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b45f452be17f5b54f8c46069c39e0f6c931d4ce8190ab0d96cc01665e3726746.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

 
• **ISLE : GNVL**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88af105ca2b7300397bc46dc318ee77ea3d743866433435dae8990c32a1019dd.png] 

 

and

 
• **JUMP : ROXM**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88af105ca2b7300397bc46dc318ee77ea3d743866433435dae8990c32a1019dd.png] 

Similarly,

 
• **KATE : ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88af105ca2b7300397bc46dc318ee77ea3d743866433435dae8990c32a1019dd.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "GVDN".
